title: Vertical Social Clip - Juicy Gameplay Moment
summary: A loopable 9:16 clip of one satisfying gameplay moment for short-video platforms: hit-stop, screen shake, particles, chunky damage numbers and a combo payoff, framed inside the safe area so platform buttons and captions never cover the action.
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 gameplay clip, about 8 seconds, built to stop the scroll on short-video platforms. It shows one extremely satisfying moment of game feel and loops seamlessly.

Game: {argument name="game_pitch" default="a pixel-art arena brawler where a tiny chef fights waves of angry vegetables with a frying pan"}.
Art style: {argument name="art_style" default="bright, chunky pixel art with thick outlines and a vertical playfield"}.
The moment: {argument name="moment" default="the chef charges a spin attack, hits a crowd of carrots, and the last enemy explodes into a shower of coins"}.

# Beat structure
- 0-1s: instant action, the player already moving. No intro, no title.
- 1-5s: build-up: {argument name="build_up" default="enemies gather, the spin attack charges with a growing glow and rising pitch"}.
- 5-6.5s: payoff with heavy juice: 3-4 frame hit-stop on impact, strong screen shake, white hit flashes, squash and stretch on enemies, bursting particles, big chunky damage numbers, and a combo counter popping up to {argument name="combo" default="x12"}.
- 6.5-8s: settle back toward the opening pose so the clip loops without a visible cut.

# Vertical framing and safe area
- Keep all key action inside the centre 60% of the frame height.
- Leave the top 12% and bottom 20% free of important action (platform captions, username and buttons sit there), and keep the right 15% clear of key action (like and share buttons).
- Camera locked or gently following; the player always near the vertical centre.

# Look and sound
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="saturated warm oranges and greens on a dark navy floor for maximum pop"}.
- Punchy impact sound, rising charge tone, coin shower jingle. No voice-over.

# Avoid
Generated captions or text other than in-game damage numbers and the combo counter, letterboxing, horizontal footage cropped to vertical, motion blur that smears pixels, slow starts, watermarks, real game or platform logos.
